name: Admin Document Folders and Tags
description: Organize admin documents with folders and tags: root-folder sidebar navigation, tag filter chips, and folder/tag management modals. In the folder manager modal, the 'Nueva carpeta' form's 'Dentro de:' parent selector defaults to the currently active folder, so creating a folder while standing inside a child folder pre-selects that folder as the parent (still changeable to any folder or root).
